partners.mechanism_chain: ELANE (HGNC:3046) —DISRUPTS→ Neutrophil elastase activity (GO:0001822); Neutrophil elastase activity (GO:0001822) —LEADS_TO→ Severe congenital neutropenia (MONDO:0042490); PLG (HGNC:9194) —DISRUPTS→ Plasminogen activation cascade (GO:0007590); Plasminogen activation cascade (GO:0007590) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoplasminogenemia (MONDO:0009009); Plasminogen activation cascade (GO:0007590) —DECREASES→ Fibrin (CHEBI:17790); Neutrophil elastase activity (GO:0001822) —DECREASES→ Fibrin (CHEBI:17790).
